import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ResidueParameterChange
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ExactDifferentialResidue
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DifferentialDivisor
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DifferentialOrderRegular

/-!
# Intrinsic residues of rational differentials

Change-of-parameter invariance yields a residue map independent of all local
choices. Its local normalization, vanishing on regular and exact differentials,
and finite support are proved here. Uniqueness explicitly requires vanishing on
regular differentials in addition to the specified-parameter monomial values.
The general global residue theorem and the Serre trace remain separate.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- The residue of a rational differential at a closed point. A uniformizer
is selected for the definition; `curveRationalDifferentialResidue_eq` proves
that every uniformizer gives the same map. -/
def curveRationalDifferentialResidue {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    CurveRationalDifferentials X →ₗ[k] k := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  let h := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
  exact curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx h.choose h.choose_spec

/-- Any local parameter computes the intrinsic residue. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_eq
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidue X hx =
      curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht := by
  unfold curveRationalDifferentialResidue
  exact curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq X hx _ t _ ht

/-- The intrinsic residue extends the previously constructed simple-pole
residue. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_eq_simplePole
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidue X hx ω = curveSimplePoleResidueToBase X hx ω := by
  unfold curveRationalDifferentialResidue
  exact curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_simplePole X hx _ _ ω

/-- Regular differentials have zero residue. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_eq_zero_of_regular
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    {ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X} (hω : ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidue X hx ω = 0 := by
  unfold curveRationalDifferentialResidue
  exact curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_of_regular X hx _ _ hω

/-- Every ground-field scalar occurs as a residue. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_surjective
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    Function.Surjective (curveRationalDifferentialResidue X hx) := by
  unfold curveRationalDifferentialResidue
  exact curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_surjective X hx _ _

/-- Intrinsic residues have the normalized values on every integer monomial
in every local parameter, in arbitrary characteristic. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_zpow_smul
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℤ) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidue X hx
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ n •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)) =
        if n = -1 then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidue_eq X hx t ht]
  exact curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_zpow_smul X hx t ht n

/-- Exact rational differentials have zero intrinsic residue. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_differential
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (f : X.left.functionField) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidue X hx (KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField f) = 0 := by
  unfold curveRationalDifferentialResidue
  exact curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_differential X hx _ _ f

/-- Regular vanishing and the values on negative parameter monomials uniquely
determine the residue as a linear map. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_unique
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (r : CurveRationalDifferentials X →ₗ[k] k)
    (hregular : ∀ ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x, r ω = 0)
    (hmonomial : ∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 →
      r (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ n •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)) =
        if n = -1 then 1 else 0) : r = curveRationalDifferentialResidue X hx := by
  apply curveRationalDifferentialLinearMap_ext_of_parameter_monomials X hx t ht
  · intro ω hω
    rw [hregular ω hω, curveRationalDifferentialResidue_eq_zero_of_regular X hx hω]
  · intro n hn
    rw [hmonomial n hn, curveRationalDifferentialResidue_zpow_smul X hx t ht]

/-- On a quasi-compact smooth curve, a rational differential has only
finitely many nonzero residues. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_support_finite [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    (Function.support (fun p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left} =>
      curveRationalDifferentialResidue X p.2 ω)).Finite := by
  by_cases hω : ω = 0
  · simp [hω]
  refine (curveDifferentialOrder_support_finite X ω hω).subset ?_
  intro p hp horder
  apply hp
  exact curveRationalDifferentialResidue_eq_zero_of_regular X p.2
    ((curveDifferentialOrder_nonneg_iff X p.2 ω hω).mp (by rw [horder]))

end
end Hartshorne
